description: PRIMARY TOOL — call this immediately for any "preview", "deploy", "get a URL", or "share my project" request. Do NOT read project files or try to run the project locally first. Before calling: (1) run `git remote get-url origin` to get the repo URL and extract owner/repo, (2) run `git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD` for the current branch. This tool auto-creates the project if needed, builds the branch, waits up to 5 minutes, and returns the live HTTPS URL.

branch.description: Branch to deploy. Defaults to the project default branch (usually main).

gitProvider.description: Git host of the repository (default: github). Derive it from the origin URL host.

githubRepo.description: Repository path, e.g. acme/quick-invoice (owner/repo; GitLab subgroups allowed)

projectName.description: Display name for the project if it needs to be created (defaults to the repo name).

name: deploy_repo
